messages:
Jenna (AE): Heads-up — ACME sent a combined security + procurement note. Key asks: proof-of-domain (can't rely on tenant email alone), SCIM delta vs full sync behavior, RBAC mapping from Okta groups, SAML attribute mapping, and whether high SCIM throughput affects pricing. They want a short POC in ~2 weeks. Can @Sam (SE) + @Tara (Security) weigh in?

Sam (SE): Quick answers / clarifications:
- Domain proof: support DNS TXT or email verification; for enterprise we can do tenant-locking (DNS TXT + admin consent) so a domain map requires both.
- SAML: standard SAML 2.0, support for IdP-initiated + SP-initiated. We map assertion attributes into role claims via a configurable attribute map.
- SCIM: implements SCIM 2.0 endpoints, supports incremental (delta) sync using `startIndex/totalResults` + `If-Modified-Since` for filtering. Pagination is 100/users per page by default.
- Rate limits: default hosted limits are conservative (30 req/s per tenant). For Dedicated/POC we can raise that to 200 req/s or provide a burst window.
- RBAC: we support mapping Okta groups -> Redwood roles; group-to-role mapping is configurable at tenant level.
- Sample curl for SCIM list: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users?startIndex=1&count=100`

Tara (Security): Additional security notes:
- All traffic TLS1.2+, we support mutual TLS for private deployments.
- At-rest encryption for keys + model state, audit logs with token-level tracing retained per contract.
- We can provide SOC 2 Type II report, DPA template, and subprocessor list. Will need to confirm data residency requirement (EU/US).
- Certificate rotation: we support automated cert rollover and IDP cert fingerprint checks; advise 7-day overlap window during rotation.

Michael (Legal): Please get me the customer's exact DPA edits. Also need to know if SCIM contains PII beyond name/email (e.g., manager, location) — that changes DPA scoping. If they want custom logging retention or export controls, flag now.

Ravi (ACME IT): We will only send name/email/employee-id initially. We do plan to sync manager+location later. Also need SSO to allow role elevation via Okta group membership. Pricing team asked if increased SCIM rates change monthly bill during POC.

Priya (PM): For the POC logistics:
- We can provision a short-lived Dedicated POC pool for 2 weeks (isolated, higher rate limits) — requires approval from sales for the budget impact.
- Alternatively use hosted with temporary rate raise, but need explicit SAC (support allocation) window.
- Checklist for POC: test tenant, IdP metadata, SCIM token, sample users CSV, and the security questionnaire pdf.

Jenna (AE): @Sam can you confirm the delta vs full semantics we should tell ACME (they asked for exact behavior on deletions and soft-deletes)? Also can you give a ballpark price uplift for the 2-week Dedicated POC? I need numbers for procurement. :eyes:

Sam (SE): Deletions: we use `active:false` and keep tombstones for 7 days by default to support eventual consistency; we can extend retention if they need a longer grace period. For true hard deletes we support immediate removal but advise caution for downstream systems.

On pricing: rough numbers (ballpark for approval only) — 2-week Dedicated POC with boosted SCIM throughput and reserved GPUs: ~$5k - $8k depending on GPU tier and support SLA. Hosted + burst window (no dedicated GPUs) is cheaper (~$1k - $1.5k) but rate raise needs manual approval. I'll get firm quotes from finance.

Tara (Security): I'll prepare a short security summary we can hand to ACME (SOC2, DPA link, cert rotation notes, audit log retention and encryption). Jenna, drop the questionnaire here or link it and I'll fill it. :thumbsup:

Jenna (AE): Uploading the questionnaire to the thread and SFDC now — https://redwood.sfdc/opp/ACME-12345/qna (internal link).

Michael (Legal): Once I get the customer's DPA edits, I can run the redlines same day. If they require EU-only processing, we need a quick call to confirm architecture for Private deployment.

Ravi (ACME IT): Ok — can we schedule the technical kickoff this Friday? Need someone from engineering + security on the call.

Jenna (AE): Friday works. @Sam @Tara pls confirm availability. We'll close with an action list: 1) Sam: firm rate & pricing quote, 2) Tara: security summary, 3) Michael: DPA turnaround time, 4) Jenna: schedule call + send POC checklist.

Sam (SE): Confirmed Friday morning. I'll bring SCIM examples and role-mapping demo.

Tara (Security): Confirmed.

Jenna (AE): Great — moving to calendar. Thanks all. :rocket:
